settings.question: Will this fit my car, SUV, or truck?
settings.answer: Yes! The SafePet Rear Seat Cover is engineered with universal 53″ × 51″ dimensions (20″ seat depth + 26.5″ backrest + 4.5″ front drop) designed to fit virtually all standard sedans, midsize/full-size SUVs, and pickup trucks. Adjustable headrest straps and tuck-in seat anchors ensure a custom snug fit.

settings.question: Can I still use the center armrest or fold down seats?
settings.answer: Yes! Built with heavy-duty split center zippers, you can easily unzip the center section to lower your vehicle's center armrest and cup holders, or share the backseat comfortably with human passengers.

settings.question: Does this work with the SafePet Dog Seatbelt?
settings.answer: Absolutely! It features reinforced velcro pass-through slits that line up with standard vehicle seatbelt buckles, allowing you to easily click in your SafePet Dog Seatbelt to keep your pup securely tethered.

settings.question: How do I clean and wash it?
settings.answer: For everyday dirt, dog hair, or drool, simply wipe clean with a damp cloth or vacuum in seconds. For muddy paws and spills, it is 100% machine washable on cold/gentle cycle (air dry or tumble dry low).

settings.question: Will it slip around on smooth leather seats?
settings.answer: No! The bottom is lined with a high-traction non-slip rubber mesh, paired with quick-insert seat anchors that tuck deeply into the seat cushion crevice to prevent shifting during sharp turns or sudden braking.

settings.title: SAVED MY BEIGE LEATHER SEATS!
settings.body: We have two German Shepherds who love muddy trail hikes. My previous cover was thin, bunched up, and allowed mud to soak right into the perforated leather. SafePet's diamond quilting is thick, 100% waterproof, and doesn't budge even when the dogs jump in soaking wet. Absolute 10/10.

settings.title: The center armrest zipper is pure genius.
settings.body: Most seat covers block the middle armrest completely. This one lets me unzip the center to drop down the cup holders for my kids, while our Lab sits happily on the side. Plus, the seatbelt slits let us click in the SafePet strap easily.

settings.title: Installs in 2 minutes & cleans with a wipe.
settings.body: I commute with my dog every day. The seat anchors keep it locked into place so it never shifts. When it gets full of fur or dirt, I just take a damp microfiber cloth and wipe it clean in 30 seconds.
